text:
maria_sales: Quick help please 12 MedriTech POC blocked on signature routing. They have two legal entities and DocuSign keeps rejecting the second signer with a role mismatch. Customer wants Net45 and an EU HSM addendum. We need an interim path so infra can spin up POC cluster this week.

docusign-bot: system: envelope validation failed. code=ROLE_MISMATCH
```
invalid_recipient: role 'EntityB_Signer' email 'carla+test@medritech.eu' did not match template mapping
call: POST /v2/envelopes/validate
```
maria_sales: @rob_procure @lina_legal can we take PO+signed MSA from the primary entity for now and a consent letter from the second, or do we need full countersign?

rob_procure: PO is an option. Finance will accept PO# + billing contact to allow provisioning under Net45, but accounting needs the legal reference (MSA or envelope ID) on the invoice. If we do consent letter, it must reference the orderform by PO#.

lina_legal: Short answer: for POC we can accept primary-signature + secondary consent letter referencing the MSA and orderform. For production we'll need countersign by both entities or the HSM addendum executed by the entity that controls keys. I'll prepare a two-paragraph consent template. ETA 8h.

cal_eng: From tech: we can create a temporary sub-account and issue scoped API keys so they can run the POC without waiting for full production sign-off. That removes the blocker. We'll require an explicit acceptance of POC terms in email (simple ack) and an assigned PO to enable Net45 billing.

kate_finance: Confirming numbers: HSM add-on is a 15% surcharge on the Dedicated key management line. Need a line-item on the orderform: "EU HSM (monthly)" with amount and the PO# to route approvals. If we get PO in 24h we can set Net45; otherwise invoice will default to Net15.

maria_sales: OK I'll ask MedriTech for PO and the contact for second signer. Lina, please send the consent template and the HSM addendum draft to procurement@medritech.com and cc billing@redwood.com. Cal, can you stand up sub-account after we confirm PO?

lina_legal: Will do. Draft will include clause: 
```
"Entity B consents to the OrderForm executed by Entity A and acknowledges the POC scope; this consent is not a waiver of any future license or liability obligations."
```
We will keep the language narrow so it's POC-only.

rob_procure: If DocuSign keeps failing, fallback plan: two separate envelopes (one per entity) and we add cross-reference text into the orderform: "This OrderForm references MSA env IDs: ENV12345 (Entity A) and ENV12346 (Entity B)." That satisfies accounting.

ops_bot: notice: provisioning queued pending invoice metadata. Missing: PO#, billing contact, remit address. Tagging finance.

kate_finance: Also request an explicit billing GL for POC trials (non-recurring credits) so we apply the right account code.

cal_eng: I'll prep the sub-account and keep the cluster in standby. Need confirmation of PO# and the email of the secondary signer for envelope retry. If you want the CLI snippet for resending with explicit role mapping I can paste it.

maria_sales: please paste it here if it's quick.

cal_eng: snippet: 
```
docusign-cli envelopes resend --template tpl_medri_001 --roles '[{"roleName":"EntityA_Signer","email":"alice@medritech.com"},{"roleName":"EntityB_Signer","email":"carla@medritech.eu"}]' --force-validate
```
That usually fixes template placeholders.

lina_legal: One more note: HSM keys residing in EU require KMS addendum language. I'll include a short HSM attachment with: jurisdiction = EU, control = customer-managed, rotation policy reference. Keep it minimal.

maria_sales: Plan settled: 1) request PO + secondary signer email from customer now, 2) Lina sends consent template + HSM addendum draft to customer within 8h, 3) Cal stands by to reprovision sub-account and resend envelope, 4) Rob/kate will accept PO for Net45 once PO# present. Target: POC up in 72h.

rob_procure: Tracking: if PO not received in 48h escalate to AE. I'll monitor and ping account exec.

maria_sales: Thanks. I'll update when PO arrives.
